scenarios.title: Filtering by author keeps only that author's books
steps: Given the search for "dragons" shows books by "J. R. R. Tolkien" and "Naomi Novik"
When the member filters by the author "Naomi Novik"
Then only books by "Naomi Novik" are listed

scenarios.title: Clearing the filters restores every result
steps: Given the search for "dragons" is filtered by the author "Naomi Novik"
When the member clears all filters
Then every result of the search for "dragons" is listed

scenarios.title: Results are ordered by recent loans
steps: Given the search for "dragons" shows "Temeraire" with 40 recent loans and "The Hobbit" with 12
When the member sorts by "Most popular"
Then "Temeraire" is listed before "The Hobbit"

scenarios.title: Empty name is rejected
steps: Given the applicant is on the details step
When the applicant continues with the name left empty
Then an inline error is shown under the name

scenarios.title: Empty date of birth is rejected
steps: Given the applicant is on the details step
When the applicant continues with the date of birth left empty
Then an inline error is shown under the date of birth

scenarios.title: Empty address is rejected
steps: Given the applicant is on the details step
When the applicant continues with the address left empty
Then an inline error is shown under the address

scenarios.title: Future date of birth is rejected
steps: Given the applicant is on the details step
When the applicant enters a date of birth of 2099-01-01
Then an inline error is shown under the date of birth

scenarios.title: Filling in the name clears its error
steps: Given the applicant is on the details step
And the applicant has continued with the name left empty
When the applicant enters the name "Ada Lovelace"
Then no error is shown under the name

scenarios.title: Filling in the date of birth clears its error
steps: Given the applicant is on the details step
And the applicant has continued with the date of birth left empty
When the applicant enters a date of birth of 1990-05-14
Then no error is shown under the date of birth

scenarios.title: Joining creates a membership
steps: Given the applicant is on the confirm step
When the applicant presses "Join"
Then a membership number is shown

scenarios.title: Member prints a loan slip
steps: Given the member is on the loan slip of "Dune"
When the member presses "Print"
Then the print dialog shows "Dune" with the member number and the due date

scenarios.title: Results are ordered by relevance
steps: When the member searches for "dragons"
Then the results are ordered by relevance

scenarios.title: Results are ordered newest first
steps: Given the search for "dragons" shows "The Hobbit" from 1937 and "Temeraire" from 2006
When the member sorts by "Newest first"
Then "Temeraire" is listed before "The Hobbit"

scenarios.title: Relevance order continues on the next page
steps: Given the search for "dragons" returns more than 20 results
When the member opens the second page of results
Then the second page continues the relevance order of the first

scenarios.title: Newest-first order continues on the next page
steps: Given the search for "dragons" returns more than 20 results
And the member sorts by "Newest first"
When the member opens the second page of results
Then the second page continues the newest-first order of the first

scenarios.title: Member with loans sees their loans
steps: Given the member has borrowed "The Hobbit" and "Dune"
When the member opens the My Loans page
Then two loans are listed, each with its title and due date

scenarios.title: Member without loans sees the empty state
steps: Given the member has no loans
When the member opens the My Loans page
Then "You have no books on loan" is shown with a link to the catalogue

scenarios.title: Member whose loans fail to load sees the error state
steps: Given the loans service is unavailable
When the member opens the My Loans page
Then "Loans could not be loaded" is shown with a "Try again" button

scenarios.title: Borrowed books are listed with their due dates
steps: Given the member has borrowed these books:
| title      | due date   |
| The Hobbit | 2026-12-01 |
When the member opens the My Loans page
Then each book is listed in its own row with its due date

scenarios.title: The empty state shows its message in full
steps: Given the member has no loans
When the member opens the My Loans page
Then the empty state reads:
You have no books on loan.
Browse the catalogue to borrow one.

unlinked.title: The My Loans page opens from the menu
steps: Given the member is on the home page
When the member chooses "My Loans" in the menu
Then the My Loans page is shown

scenarios.title: Total fines add up across loans
steps: Given the member owes 0.40 on "The Hobbit" and 1.20 on "Dune"
When the member opens the My Loans page
Then the total fines owed is 1.60

scenarios.title: Small fines add up to the cent
steps: Given the member owes 0.10 on "The Hobbit", 0.10 on "Dune" and 0.10 on "Emma"
When the member opens the My Loans page
Then the total fines owed is 0.30

scenarios.title: A settled fine is left out of the total
steps: Given the member has a fine of 0.40 on "The Hobbit" and 1.20 on "Dune"
And the fine on "Dune" is <fine-state>
When the member opens the My Loans page
Then the total fines owed is 0.40
Examples:
| fine-state  |
| paid        |
| waived      |
| written-off |

scenarios.title: The total adds up for any number of loans
steps: Given the member owes <fine> on each of <loans> loans
When the member opens the My Loans page
Then the total fines owed is <total>
Examples: A few loans
| loans | fine | total |
Examples: Many loans
| loans | fine | total |

scenarios.title: Signed-in member is redirected to My Loans
steps: Given a member is signed in
When the member opens "/join"
Then the My Loans page is displayed

scenarios.title: A renewed loan lists the date of each renewal
steps: Given the member renewed "Dune" on 2026-11-02 and on 2026-11-16
When the member opens the loan detail page for "Dune"
Then the renewal history lists 2026-11-02 and 2026-11-16

background: Given a member in good standing is signed in

scenarios.title: Member borrows an available book
steps: Given the book "The Hobbit" is available
When the member borrows "The Hobbit" from the catalogue
Then "The Hobbit" is listed on the My Loans page
And the loan shows a due date

scenarios.title: Member is offered a loan slip
steps: Given the book "Dune" is available
When the member borrows "Dune" from the catalogue
Then a printable loan slip for "Dune" is offered

scenarios.title: Borrowed books are listed with their due dates
scenarios.rule: A member borrows within the loan limit of their category
rule_background: Given the loan limit for the member's category is 3
steps: Given the member holds 2 loans
And the book "Emma" is available
When the member borrows "Emma" from the catalogue
Then "Emma" is listed on the My Loans page with its due date

scenarios.title: Member at the loan limit is told why they cannot borrow
scenarios.rule: A member borrows within the loan limit of their category
rule_background: Given the loan limit for the member's category is 3
steps: Given the member holds 3 loans
And the book "Emma" is available
When the member tries to borrow "Emma" from the catalogue
Then the loan is refused with "You have reached your loan limit of 3"

scenarios.title: Applicant joins the library
steps: Given an applicant named "<name>" is on the sign-up wizard
When the applicant completes every step of the wizard
Then a membership number is shown on the confirmation step
And a confirmation email with that membership number is sent to "<email>"
Examples:
| name         | email                 |
| Ada Lovelace | ada@example.org       |
| Alan Turing  | alan.t@example.org    |

scenarios.title: Adult applicant gets an adult card
steps: Given an applicant aged 34 is on the card type step
Then the "Adult" card type is offered

scenarios.title: Junior applicant gets a junior card
steps: Given an applicant aged 12 is on the card type step
Then the "Junior" card type is offered

scenarios.title: Desk staff register a resident
steps: Given a resident hands in a completed paper form
When the desk staff register the resident
Then a membership card is printed for the resident

unlinked.title: Catalogue page loads
steps: When a visitor opens "/catalogue"
Then the catalogue search box is shown

unlinked.title: Sign-up wizard loads
steps: When a visitor opens "/join"
Then the details step is shown
